where: top edge of the cliff wall near the center
desc: A sharp vertical seam cuts straight through the cliff mesh where terrain assets meet.

verify.why: This is an open mesh termination exposing the background void rather than a seam where two terrain assets join.

desc: Overlapping roofs and dense wooden structures obscure the path below, making the connection between the upper cliff and lower dock unclear.

verify.why: The stairways, ramps, and platforms connecting the upper cliff and lower docks are clearly visible and legible from this perspective.

desc: A roof canopy structure floats high against the cliff side without visible support columns or attachments.

verify.why: The canopy roof near the upper right cliff is properly attached to support beams anchored into the platform below.

where: main pathway on the right hillside
desc: Harsh dark shadows combined with overlapping fences make it difficult to discern walkable ground from drop-offs along the cliff path.

verify.why: The broad dirt pathway along the right hillside is clearly delineated by fences and easily readable.

where: dark opening on the upper cliffside
desc: The pitch-black cave opening lacks visual cues or clear path connections, making it ambiguous whether it serves as a playable route or non-interactive backdrop.

verify.why: The elevated wooden bridge leads directly into the cave opening, providing a clear path connection.

desc: The wooden staircase built into the steep cliff face terminates abruptly into the terrain without a clear landing or pathway transition.

verify.why: The staircase transitions smoothly onto the upper plateau ground next to the building rather than terminating abruptly.

desc: The visual similarity between wooden roofs and wooden walkways makes it ambiguous which elevated surfaces are walkable paths and which are building tops.

verify.why: The sloped green roofs are easily distinguished from the flat brown boardwalks equipped with railings.

desc: Rooftops and wooden walkways share identical colors and textures, making it difficult to distinguish navigable paths from non-walkable roofs.

verify.why: The green-tinted sloped roof surfaces have distinct color and geometry from the flat brown walkway planks.

where: cave entrance in the upper cliff
desc: The dark cave opening at the top left lacks lighting or framing, making it ambiguous whether it is an accessible tunnel or decorative cliff geometry.

verify.why: The cave entrance is framed and directly serviced by the upper wooden walkway structure, clearly signalling it as an accessible passage.

desc: The dense row of cloth panels along the upper deck railing blocks sightlines to the walkways and structures behind it.

verify.why: Decorative cloth panels mounted on a deck railing naturally obscure sightlines behind them and serve as normal environmental set dressing.
